title: Join two 1×1 blocks
instruction: Press the red block onto the blue block, connecting one stud. Lift the pair by the red block alone so the blue block is at least 2 cm above the table for one second. Set the joined pair down upright and let go for one second.
context: Joining construction pieces supports assistance with hands-on play and model building. The target requires gripping two small pieces and retaining their single stud/socket connection.
setup: Two custom press-fit bricks with solid printed PLA as the material target: blue 1×1 brick: 15.8 × 15.8 mm footprint, 19.2 mm body plus 4.8 mm studs, 3.907 g model mass, body centre (0.26, 0.1, 0.7571) m; red 1×1 brick: 15.8 × 15.8 mm footprint, 19.2 mm body plus 4.8 mm studs, 3.907 g model mass, body centre (0.2, 0.2, 0.7571) m. Studs face up; edges align with world X/Y. Stud pitch 16 mm; diameter 9.6 mm. Oak-coloured 1.10 × 1.30 m tabletop, centre X=0.36 m/Y=0, top Z=0.7475 m. Two YAM arms start in the station ready pose. No layout jitter. Printable CAD and exact socket dimensions are included.
scoring: 0: no qualifying pickup. 0.25: hold red’s lowest point at least 20 mm above the table for 0.20 s. 0.5: after pickup, seat exactly 1 stud(s), centre error ≤1 mm, gap ≤0.75 mm and tilt ≤3°, for 0.20 s. 1: also hold blue’s lowest point ≥20 mm above the table for 1 s while holding red only, then release the pair for 1 s: blue bottom within 3 mm of table, upright within 3°, both arms ≥5 mm clear, both bricks stable within 2 mm/5°. During lift, all robot surfaces must be ≥2 mm from blue. Use final score; separation removes connection credit. Score 0 if any brick part exits X[−0.17,0.89] m/Y[−0.63,0.63] m (20 mm inside table edges) or falls >15 mm below the tabletop.
reset_notes: Separate the bricks and return them upright to the fixed positions. Replace damaged printed parts.
fidelity: Custom printable press-fit bricks at Duplo scale, not official LEGO parts. Rigid hollow shapes use compliant contact and friction at socket rings; no attachment joint. Contact overlap approximates local compliance: plastic bending, fracture and print tolerances are not simulated. Fit, insertion force and pull-out force have not been calibrated to physical prints.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0; demo: 1. Dream: 25 requests, 26 attempts, 1 retry across 2 sessions (1 recovered request); recovery effects are unknown.
